newsitem.title: YUGOSLAVIA: Serbia's Zastava and Italy's Iveco restore ties.
newsitem.headline: Serbia's Zastava and Italy's Iveco restore ties.

text.p: Serbia's truck factory Zastava Kamioni from Kragujevac and Italy's Iveco restored cooperation after a five-year break and relaunched their joint venture Zastava Iveco, Belgrade daily Nasa Borba said on Friday.

"Recent talks in Turin were the first official contacts between the two sides in five years and resulted in resumption of work of the joint venture Zastava Iveco," Dragan Srejovic, Vice-President of the Zastava group, was quoted as saying.
Iveco holds a 46 percent stake in the joint venture.
Zastava Iveco plans to produce 1,000 trucks for local markets and 200 for export by the end of 1997. It also plans to assemble 100 heavy Eurocargo trucks of 11-tonne capacity.
Jeftimir Cvetkovic, director of the joint venture, said the company planned to double its production in 1998 and reach pre-sanctions production level by the year 2000.
Cvetkovic also said the company would have to downsize and lay off some workers because of reduced production.
Redundant workers could be re-hired when production picked up, he said.
